MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire HD 8 feels like a useful next step from my Fire 7: it offers more built-in storage and a slightly larger screen while staying portable. The HD 10 also interests me, but I would choose the more compact HD 8 now.",
    "The Fire TV Stick gives my existing TV a new use through streaming. That practical addition appeals to me even though my 720p TV would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and Echo Show add voice-assistant features I have no current use for. Having a Fire tablet does not mean I want voice control throughout my home.",
    "The Blink bundle addresses home security, while my photography purchases involve tripods, memory cards, and a lens cap. The earbuds likewise do not address a need I am currently pursuing.",
    "Another 16 GB Fire 7 feels redundant because I already have one; a replacement needs a meaningful improvement to interest me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire 7 purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of Amazon devices, although most of those devices serve different purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as general interest in new gadgets, while I usually choose items for a specific task or an existing device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of storage cards, cables, mounts, holders, and power strips suggest that making my existing equipment more useful matters to me.",
    "The exact equipment I already have matters: a tablet upgrade should improve storage or screen size, and a TV accessory should be useful with my 720p set.",
    "My latest lens-cap purchase and earlier photography accessories provide a more concrete clue to my needs than simply having bought electronics."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical entertainment upgrades, but stretched my Fire tablet purchase into an interest in smart-home devices that I do not currently need."
}
